decisions.reason: Gli3 Xt-J mutant, loss of Bmp/Wnt in cortical hem and dorsal telencephalon ventralisation; generic cortical-hem/cortex patterning in mouse, no link to the rostral midline roof or paraphysis territory.
Two posterior fossa ependyma-lined cysts and common pathogenesis of epithelial/ependymal cysts; not third-ventricle colloid cyst and no paraphyseal argument.
Lhx2 restricts cortical hem extent in mouse; hem/cortex patterning only, does not address the telencephalic midline roof rostral to the choroid plexus.
General review of choroid plexus development at four roof sites; generic choroid plexus, no treatment of the paraphysis region, telencephalon impar or tela choroidea boundary.

Neoceratodus pituitary vascularisation paper; excerpt is only the figure abbreviation list that labels both 'Pa paraphysis' and 'SD saccus dorsalis' in a lungfish brain; resolving needs the figure legend/text to see whether the paraphysis is actually described or merely labelled.
Case report of intrapontomesencephalic (brainstem) colloid cyst with brief review of brainstem neuroepithelial cyst origin; not third-ventricle and no paraphyseal discussion.
Lamprey retina and pineal complex immunocytochemistry (pineal/parapineal photoreceptive organs); no paraphysis or dorsal-sac territory.
SCO secretory glycoprotein binding sites on choroid plexus; generic SCO/choroid plexus, no comparison with the paraphysis.

Roof plate ablation and Lhx2 regulation in mouse dorsal telencephalon/cortical size; cortex-patterning focus, not the midline derivative territory (the roof-plate question is covered by Cheng 2006 R426).
Clinicopathologic series of 145 CNS cysts (38 colloid) with generic histogenesis remark; abstract gives no paraphyseal or colloid-specific origin argument.
Colloid cysts in identical twins, genetic implications only; no histogenesis or paraphyseal origin data.
Chick Wnt8b/Wnt7b expression in cortical hem, zli and medial pallium; hem/pallial patterning, not the rostral roof/paraphysis region.

Bmpr1a conditional knockout shows BMP signalling is required locally to pattern the dorsal telencephalic midline and to specify the telencephalic choroid plexus (most dorsomedial derivative); helps with the molecular patterning of the roof that borders the paraphysis territory (ontogeny/molecular).
Full abstract checked: structure and apoptosis markers of the human telencephalic choroid plexus primordium at weeks 5-6; no mention of paraphysis or adjoining rostral roof landmarks.
Case report of spontaneous rupture of presumed colloid cyst with wall remnants at anterior third-ventricle roof; imaging/natural history only, no histogenesis.
FNA cytomorphology of 10 colloid cysts; restates the misplaced endodermal origin as background but offers no histogenesis analysis weighing a paraphyseal origin.
Evolution of transthyretin synthesis in the choroid plexus; generic choroid plexus physiology, no paraphysis link.
Familial colloid cysts (half sisters), inheritance and endocrine follow-up; no histogenesis or paraphyseal argument.
Review of nonvisual photoreceptors of deep brain, pineal organs and retina; abstract does not address the paraphysis or telencephalic roof, pineal-complex topic only.
Hindbrain roof plate and choroid plexus lineage mapping (rhombencephalic), not telencephalic.
Teleost (Catla) pineal complex with dorsal sac epithelium columnar/ciliated and pineal-gonad endocrinology; no paraphysis data and no comparison with it.
Review of corpus callosum development from commissural plate and BMP/holoprosencephaly; full abstract checked, no paraphysis or localisation of roof derivatives rostral to the choroid plexus.
Hagfish reduced ventricular system with CSF-contacting neurons, choroid plexus absent; no paraphysis discussion.
Carp pineal complex (end vesicle, stalk, dorsal sac) and photoperiod response; teleost pineal dorsal sac with no paraphysis comparison.
Crx/Otx5 gene-family phylogeny (retina and epiphysis); off-topic for the paraphysis.

Full abstract checked: rat E12-E16 forebrain morphogenesis names the telencephalon impar between the vesicles and places choroid plexus origins there at E15; useful for locating the midline roof/impar territory (ontogeny, anatomy); mammal, no paraphysis mentioned.
Review of benign CNS cyst walls; excerpt only says colloid cyst origin remains obscure, no evaluation of paraphyseal or other histogenesis (full text unseen, verified from the excerpt only).
p73 in Cajal-Retzius cells, cortical hem and choroid plexus in mouse; cortical patterning, no paraphysis.
Emx1/Emx2 double mutant converts archipallium to roof without hem or choroid plexus; archipallium/hem specification, not the rostral roof territory.
General book on brain evolution (regional scaling); metadata only, finder found no passage on paraphysis, dorsal sac or telencephalon impar.

Tuatara pineal complex histology: describes the paraphysis as an evagination of the lamina supraneuroporica, multisaccular, presumed secretory, opening shifted to the dorsal sac (Dendy), with its position relative to pineal eye and dorsal sac.

Light/EM microscopy of the turtle Trachemys dorbigni paraphysis (vascular neuroepithelial structure, cuboidal epithelium, dense bodies); paraphysis is the sole subject. Not in PubMed; authorship conflict and probable duplicate of R412.

Same turtle paraphysis paper as R411 (light, SEM, TEM, Evans blue shows fenestrated endothelium and no blood-brain barrier; circumventricular absorptive/secretory organ); paraphysis is the principal subject. Treat as duplicate of R411 on merging.

General comparative neuroanatomy textbook, metadata only; may define the paraphysis in passing but nothing seen. An index/chapter check on the telencephalon roof and ventricular system would resolve whether there is substantive treatment.
Two-page Comment on the tuatara pineal eye (no abstract; MeSH only pineal gland, photoreceptors, evolution); title and indexing point to the pineal eye, not the paraphysis.

Gdf7 fate-map and dorsal midline ablation distinguish a small anterior from a large posterior telencephalic choroid plexus epithelial domain with different lineage and apoptosis; bears on how the telencephalic midline roof is subdivided rostrally (ontogeny/molecular); mouse, paraphysis not mentioned.

Zic4 expression at the dorsal forebrain midline, telencephalon-diencephalon boundary, lamina terminalis and third-ventricle choroid plexus; candidate marker for the territory in which the paraphysis forms (molecular/ontogeny); mouse, paraphysis not mentioned.
Chick SCO grafts and Reissner's fibre formation; glycoprotein binding to choroid plexus, no comparison with paraphysis.
Clinical case of familial colloid cyst presenting with cardiorespiratory arrest; no histogenesis.
Emx2/Pax6/Otx cooperation in caudal forebrain primordium giving archipallium, hem, choroid plexus and choroidal roof; fate-mapping of caudal forebrain, not the rostral midline roof or paraphysis.
Rat Lmx1a mutant with choroid plexus and callosum maldevelopment; generic roof-plate derivative pathology, no paraphysis link.
Transthyretin synthesis in SCO ependyma versus choroid plexus; no comparison with the paraphysis.
Galanin-like immunoreactivity mapping in the snake brain (subfornical, subcommissural organs); no paraphysis.
p73/Reelin in Cajal-Retzius cells and rudimentary cortical hem in lizard, mouse and human; hem comparison only, paraphysis not addressed.

Genetic ablation shows telencephalic roof plate is needed for dorsal midline induction and its loss causes holoprosencephaly; defines roof-plate role in the telencephalic dorsal midline from which choroid plexus and rostral roof structures derive (ontogeny/molecular); mouse, paraphysis not mentioned.
Ascidian neural gland homology with vertebrate peri-ventricular organs and choroid plexus; no mention of the paraphysis in the excerpt.
